prior_defect_dispositions.finding: Exact trimmed Q preserves case and interior characters and is distinct from normalized N. Nonempty queries use canonical relevance order; browse uses label order. Cursor scope hashes exact OperationScope plus policy/epoch. Explicit TaskManager/taskmanager, case-sensitive stable-ID and whitespace examples define compatibility. Client keys reject late responses across Q changes.

Normative closed scalar types, intervals, per-operation data/scope shapes, section/source/marker unions, effective-limit fields and error metadata are now stated. Each error has one HTTP status, fixed message and retry enum. Session/health shapes are separately closed. Minimal-error byte proof remains an implementation check, not a proposal-level runtime claim.

Full items and typed detail markers share one ordered logical result stream. A marker consumes exactly its stable key and remains visibly incomplete; merely deferred items do not consume keys. If even a marker/cursor cannot fit, resource_limit terminates without hidden skipping or automatic retry. First/middle oversized-item examples preserve identity order. Text/source continuation requires nonempty Unicode-boundary progress.

The startup manifest is tied to actual verified loaded source bytes and a supervisor/worker handshake rather than only post-import disk hashes. Executable/schema/asset drift is sticky, revokes sessions/cursors, stops new knowledge/assets, and requires a fresh service/client epoch. Reloadable data refresh remains distinct; late cross-epoch responses are not applied.
